title: Comparison of failure-bit counts
statement: Let $\delta'$ be rational with $0<\delta'\leq 1/2$, and let $\delta>0$ be real. If $\min(\delta,1/2)/2<\delta'$, then the failure-bit count $\lceil\log_2\lceil 2/\delta'\rceil\rceil$ is at most the real restricted Fourier-weight failure-bit count $\lceil\log_2\lceil 4/\min(\delta,1/2)\rceil\rceil$.
